question: Which of the following gases is filled into incandescent bulbs to prolong the life of the filament?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Nitrogen.**__**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Nitrogen** is a commonly used gas used to fill incandescent light bulbs.
 
• It increases bulb life by **preventing the tungsten filaments from deteriorating** too quickly.
 
• Nitrogen is important for plant growth and can be 'fixed' by lightning or added to soils in fertilisers.
 
• It is a **colourless, odourless gas**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Oxygen is a** colourless, odourless and tasteless gas. It is noncombustible, but will actively support the burning of combustible materials. 
 
• Ozone (O₃) is a **highly reactive gas** composed of three oxygen atoms. It is both a natural and a man-made product that occurs in the Earth's upper atmosphere. 
 
• **Carbon dioxide **is an important **greenhouse gas **that helps to trap heat in our atmosphere. Without it, our planet would be inhospitably cold.
